title: Rotor design and testing
description: Selected airfoil profile for efficient turbine blade design
Calculated velocity triangles and aerodynamic forces for incoming wind and rotational speeds
Built Python script implementing BEM theory to compute induction factors and blade twist angles
Designed 2-bladed rotor template with optimal twist angles and chord distribution constrained by wood size
Drew chord curve directly on balsa wood and cut out blade shape with saw
Carved airfoil profile using cardboard templates at maximum chord location
Sanded blades to final thickness (3mm tip) to achieve target thickness-to-chord ratio
Assembled 2-bladed rotor on test tower with force transducer and laser RPM sensor (tachometer) and torque measurement scale
Tested at 3 m/s wind speed, and measured thrust, torque, RPM, and calculated power coefficient

title: Heat Storage
description: Designed thermal energy storage system using phase-change paraffin wax (melting at 58°C)
Optimized energy density per volume and weight within constraints
Calculated heat transfer through conduction, convection, and radiation using thermal circuit analogy
Built cylindrical storage: inner aluminum can with water/resistors, outer can with paraffin wax
Insulated with 10cm Rockwool (low thermal conductivity) and reflective aluminum foil
Designed electrical heating system: two 10Ω resistors in series, powered at 137A to reach 63°C
Instrumented with temperature sensors (Grafana monitoring) inside water, wax, exterior, and ambient
Developed Python simulation using Euler's method to model cooldown process across three phases
Tested in lab: measured 48-hour heat retention, isothermal phase-change plateau at 57°C
Compared experimental data to theoretical model, achieving good correlation with adjusted convection coefficients
Identified optimal usage: heat to just above melting point, extract energy within 10 hours

title: Magnetic organizer
description: Got fustrated that I didn't for all my tools in my dorm room.
Came up with the idea of a universal and scalable organizing system.
Designed the square frame that the bins and items would fit into.

title: Website (version 1)
description: Decided to rewrite my resume, as i wanted to get a student job in the future.
Realized that the classic A4 format is good for printing physical copies, but not optimal for showing the information I wanted to present.
Came up with the idea of creating a website instead, as this was more organized and entertaining due to the interactivity.
Began teaching myself the basic structure of HTML.
Realized that I would need custom styling to achive the look I wanted.
Reshearced CSS and began implementing it to create my desired look.
Came up with the idea of a dark mode button on the page.
Realized that I would need to learn JavaScript to implement the dark mode button.
Briefly dipped my toes into JavaScript and implemented the dark mode button.
Realized that this was a good learning opportunity, but that I could create a better website by leveraging a good javascript framework.
Researched different frameworks and decided to use React.
Tought myself react from scratch and advanced my javascript/typescript skills.
Coded the second version of the website, which is what you are navigating now.
